lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 4-5 horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a non-linear grid pattern posterior to the gills and pectoral fin, extending towards the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating a localized grid-like geometry most prominent in the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a high-intensity highlight on the superior edge and a low-intensity shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, faint circular blobs primarily located near the posterior margin and base of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an elongated, low-luminance object attached to the ventral region posterior to the pectoral fin, consistent with a commensal organism.
